children.name: Article Lead
children.text: Automate Gameplane through Kubernetes resources and scoped identities while keeping desired state, observed status, and audit history aligned.

children.name: Article Callout Text
children.text: Write spec, read status. Controllers own conditions and observed fields; automation should never patch them as desired state.

children.name: Section Body 1
children.text: GameServer, GameTemplate, ModuleSource, BackupSchedule, and related resources encode the platform’s declarative contracts.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 0
children.text: Use apiVersion and kind from the installed CRDs, not copied stale examples.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 1
children.text: Treat names and UIDs separately when correlating resources across restores.

children.name: Section 1 Item Text 2
children.text: Use labels and owner references for automation and cleanup.

children.name: Section Body 2
children.text: Observed generation, phase, reason, message, and conditions explain whether the controller has applied the latest intent.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 0
children.text: Wait for observedGeneration before treating status as current.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 1
children.text: Use condition type, status, reason, and timestamp in runbooks.

children.name: Section 2 Item Text 2
children.text: Watch events when a phase alone cannot explain a blocked reconciliation.

children.name: Section Body 3
children.text: Use Kubernetes RBAC for CRD workflows and scoped Gameplane service accounts for product APIs and integrations.
